title: Fix invalid canonical skill frontmatter
description:
The canonical skill frontmatter was invalid YAML (`metadata: opencode/autoinvoke: false`), so every harness that
parsed it skipped the skill instead of loading it.

Requirements: SYS007, VER007

Scope:
- Replace the invalid frontmatter value with the portable `disable-model-invocation: true` field in
  `src/.agents/skills/bead-triage/SKILL.md`.
- Add a test that parses every packaged skill and command frontmatter and asserts the invocation-control field.
- Document the fix in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`.
- Propagate the fix to the installed global assets through the installer, not by hand.

Out of scope: version bump, tag, release, and npm publication.
close_reason: Canonical skill frontmatter fixed in the packaged source with the portable disable-model-invocation field, covered by a new frontmatter test suite, documented in the changelog, and propagated to the global installation through the installer. Requirements: SYS007, VER007

title: Distribute the release through GitHub with a dependency-free artifact
description:
Distribute the release through GitHub instead of the npm registry, and keep the release artifact usable without an install step.

Scope:
- Drop the npm registry as a distribution channel: remove `publishConfig` from the manifest and document the GitHub release as the installation source.
- Remove the runtime dependency on `yaml`: the CLI judges frontmatter with its own dependency-free check (top level keys, nested blocks, quoted and plain scalars) so the published CLI runs from an unpacked tarball. `yaml` stays a development dependency for the test suite and the release validation.
- Require both judges to agree: the test suite parses every packaged frontmatter with a real YAML parser and compares that verdict with the dependency-free check.
- Document the release procedure with the GitHub CLI: validate, pack the tarball, tag, push the tag, `gh release create` with the tarball as a release asset.
- Prove the artifact works end to end: unpack the tarball without a dependency tree, run `doctor`, and install an adapter from the unpacked package.

Requirements: SYS008, VER008
close_reason: GitHub-only distribution implemented; release artifact is dependency-free and verified standalone.

comments.author: assistant
comments.text:
Implemented and verified.

Changes:
- `bin/bt-triage.js`: the YAML parser import is gone. `frontmatterProblem` now judges the frontmatter subset the package uses with no dependency: top level keys, nested blocks, quoted and plain scalars. A plain scalar that contains ": " is reported as "nested mapping in a compact value", exactly the defect class that broke the shipped skill. Constructs outside the subset are reported instead of passing silently.
- `package.json`: `yaml` moved back to devDependencies, `publishConfig` removed, `release:tarball` script added.
- `test/skill-frontmatter.test.js`: two new tests - every packaged document must get the same verdict from the dependency-free check as from a real YAML parser, and the compact nested mapping must be reported.
- `README.md`: installation from the GitHub release artifact, the release procedure with the GitHub CLI, and a note that the artifact has no runtime dependencies.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: the release now runs through GitHub releases; the `yaml` dependency change is reverted and replaced by the dependency-free frontmatter check.
- `release/release-notes.md`: user-facing release notes for `gh release create --notes-file`.

Verification:
- `npm run validate` exit 0: 101 tests, 0 failures.
- Artifact test: `npm pack` produced `release/digi4care-skill-beads-triage-0.1.0.tgz`; unpacked into a directory without a dependency tree, `node package/bin/bt-triage.js doctor` reported 8 valid packaged documents and exit 0, and `node package/bin/bt-triage.js install --target /tmp/bt-target --harness pi` wrote 9 files.
- Negative test: the same unpacked package with `disable-model-invocation: true` replaced by `metadata: opencode/autoinvoke: false` made `doctor` report `invalid frontmatter .../SKILL.md: line 3: nested mapping in a compact value`.

Requirements: SYS008, VER008

title: Validate the published artifact before release
description:
Validate the published artifact, not only the working tree, so a document that no harness can load can never be released.

Scope:
- Add `npm run verify:package`: pack the tarball, read its entries without extra dependencies, and check that the canonical skill and all seven command wrappers are present, that every packaged markdown frontmatter block parses as YAML, and that the canonical skill declares `disable-model-invocation: true`.
- Extend `bt-triage doctor` with a frontmatter check for packaged documents and for installed copies, so a stale or broken installation is reported instead of silently skipped by the harness.
- Wire the release validation into `npm run validate` (and therefore into `prepublishOnly`).

Requirements: SYS008, VER008
close_reason: Packed-tarball validation and doctor frontmatter check implemented; npm run validate green with 99 tests.

comments.author: assistant
comments.text:
Implemented and verified.

Changes:
- `scripts/verify-package.mjs` (new): packs the tarball with `npm pack --json --pack-destination <tmp>`, reads the tar entries with a dependency-free ustar reader (zlib + 512-byte headers), and fails when the canonical skill or a command wrapper is missing, when a packaged markdown frontmatter block does not parse, or when the canonical skill does not declare `disable-model-invocation: true`.
- `bin/bt-triage.js`: new `frontmatterProblem()` helper and a doctor check for packaged documents (required frontmatter) and for installed copies (reported per harness and destination). Doctor now exits 1 on a frontmatter problem.
- `package.json`: `yaml` moved from devDependencies to dependencies (the CLI validates frontmatter itself), `verify:package` script added, `validate` now runs the packed-tarball check, Biome globs extended with `scripts/`.
- `biome.json`: schema reference moved to 2.6.5.
- `test/doctor-frontmatter.test.js` (new): three tests - a valid package passes, a package with the old `metadata: opencode/autoinvoke: false` frontmatter fails with a named file, and an installed copy with broken frontmatter fails while the packaged source is valid.
- `README.md`: documents the portable invocation-control field, the doctor frontmatter check, and `npm run verify:package`.

Verification:
- `npm run validate` exit 0: 99 tests, 0 failures (was 96), Biome, markdownlint, dependency freshness, npm audit, package dry run, packed-tarball frontmatter check.
- `uvx doorstop@3.2` exit 0; SYS008/VER008 added, linked and reviewed.
- `node bin/bt-triage.js doctor` on the real home: global opencode skill 9/9, commands 7/7, pi skill 9/9, frontmatter 8 packaged documents, exit 0.
- `release/digi4care-skill-beads-triage-0.1.0.tgz` regenerated; the packed SKILL.md carries `disable-model-invocation: true`.

Requirements: SYS008, VER008
